edit.statement: Being anchored at a bank that is supervised by a regulator means being under that regulator's watch.
edit.subject: isAnchoredAt ; isSupervisedBy → isUnderWatchOf
edit.scope: Which regulator's watch a fund falls under through the bank it is anchored at.
